purpose: Formative system evaluation for a short paper; not an end-user or live-desktop task-success study.

cases.construct: reconstruction from partial events, frames, OCR, and narration
reviewable reconstruction without native input events

scoring.assertionScore: sum of weights for passing assertions divided by all assertion weights
scoring.casePass: no failed critical assertion and weighted score at least 0.80
scoring.reportPass: all cases pass and aggregate weighted score at least 0.90
scoring.criticalFailurePolicy: report every failed critical assertion individually; never average it away

knownLimits: Fixtures are synthetic and do not execute against live third-party accounts.
The suite contains 15 cases and is a construct-level formative evaluation, not a population sample.
Resource measurements are collected on one 48 GB Apple M4 Pro Mac and do not establish 16 GB performance.
Model setup uses already-downloaded weights and can benefit from operating-system file caching.
No human participants are included, so usability and non-programmer effectiveness are not measured.
